title: Arkret Snapshot Chunk Payload
description: A snapshot chunk binds exact reducer state and the verified evidence needed to recompute authorization eligibility. Ordinary data state is not a Seal state_root leaf. Different eligibility contexts merge raw evidence and recompute, never directly join projected heads.

realm_state_snapshot_ref.description: The manifest this chunk belongs to (the manifest's own primary identity is `id`; chunks point back with `realm_state_snapshot_ref`).

index.description: Position of this chunk in manifest chunks[]; the leaf sequence of state_digest is the concatenation of items[] across chunks in ascending index order.

reducer_profile.description: MUST equal the manifest reducer_profile byte for byte.

items.description: Written cells sorted by canonical CellRef, unique across the manifest. state_model must match the canonical family contract. Ordinary causal heads retain effect identities and coverage; security cells retain their last successful command revision.

conflict_records.description: Unresolved non-business inputs, never an alternate security-state winner. Ordinary concurrent heads belong in their causal state. Quarantined inputs have no business supersession power.

soft_failed.description: Accepted-but-soft-failed Event inputs inside the snapshot frontier. Committed through manifest verification_hints.soft_failed_digest.

quarantined.description: Quarantined Event inputs inside the snapshot frontier. Committed through manifest verification_hints.quarantined_digest.

erasure_stubs.description: Cells whose canonical value the issuer can no longer reproduce because a hard erasure (a storage act, not an Event) removed it. They are not state_digest leaves; each row carries the ak.schema.erasure_verification_stub.v1 bound by the erasure receipt. Committed through manifest verification_hints.erasure_stubs_digest.

eligibility_context_digest.description: Must equal the manifest eligibility context digest. Mismatched contexts cannot directly join projected Cell state.

replay_events.description: Complete original verified Event bytes required for eligibility recomputation, including retired values that may become visible after a cut. Ordered by canonical Event identity and unique across chunks. Hard erasure uses the explicit erasure-stub contract and cannot claim recoverability.

replay_authority_refs.description: Exact safety history dependencies. Resolve and verify these and all transitive producer evidence before using state; a digest without reachable material is not recoverability.

cell_item.description: One registered Cell state; identity and state_model must match the canonical registry. No implementation-defined model is permitted. The registered Cell family also fixes the full value schema and shape. Schema validation of this generic carrier alone is insufficient; a wrong family/value combination is rejected before restore.

id.description: Canonical cell tuple reference ak:cell:<component>:<subject> (encoding.md section 4). It is the leaf sort key.

heads_state.description: C/H at one verified eligibility context. covered and heads use exact Event identities for this Cell. Head identities are unique and contained in covered. Retired values must remain available through replay evidence whenever future reclassification could reveal them.

bottom_cell_record.description: Unresolved domain projection. It does not replace a causal head set or represent multiple successful security decisions.

conflicting_input_record.description: An Event input inside the frontier whose admission is still undecided (for example an unresolved full-hash collision variant).

non_accepted_input.description: One non-accepted Event input, addressable by the (actor_id, actor_seq) coordinates that realm-state-snapshot-schema.md section 6 gap attribution uses.

sequenced_state.description: Last successful command identity plus its complete value. Written null differs from never-written. Rejected commands do not modify this state.

set_state.description: Observed-remove state. Adds and removal tombstones are retained and sorted by canonical tag. Equal tags must have identical canonical values. Removal only covers dots observed in the signed basis; no arbitrary value-based removal.

log_state.description: Complete immutable entry set. Exact Event digest is identity; canonical ordering is registered in state_model_contracts. Sparse actor sequence numbers do not block inclusion or choose a sibling winner.

counter_state.description: Unique registered single-writer issuer components, canonical ActorId order. Join uses per-issuer maxima; totals never decrease. A family must register exclusive issuer ownership and authenticated cumulative update rules before use. No v1 built-in family currently uses this model; arbitrary issuer self-selection is forbidden.
